issues.details: Production Attempt executes with explicit capabilities; 99 actual state-machine scenarios plus 14 supplementary capture/preservation assertions import the inert module. CLI/OS adapter implementations are syntax-inspected, not executed.

Cumulative log polling removed. Incremental attached-stream candidate rejects UTF8/line/byte/framing/EOF/process/gap failures, but pinned Docker attach-before-start ordering not established. Plan captureOrderingEstablished=false denies real preflight before reservation.

Root PID identity, docker top PID/PPID/RSS/CPU, batch Docker stats normalized with precision caveat, separate freshness fields. WSL cgroup interface text recorded; Docker VM cgroup files remain unobservable from Ubuntu and are not claimed.

One idempotent coordinator, one TERM initiation per container, KILL only after five seconds; normal/signals/watchdog share it. Natural and signal exits separated. Independent real deadline scheduling under stalled adapters remains unresolved.
Typed lstat+O_NOFOLLOW+parent canonical checks; complete preflight repeated through same real gate before reservation; exclusive reservation ownership tracked. Real gate not executed.
Configured internal-network containment only; no empirical egress-denial assertion and no canary.

24 mocked transport cases, normal end+IncomingMessage.complete required, aborted/error/premature close/framing/media/trailer rejection. Exact kind-specific event schema and terminal dwell event. No sockets.

Runtime blocker versus permanent monitor/finalization failure separated; finalizationComplete independent of component compatibility; journal failure and result-write failure permanently block success.

testIterations.cause: Fake status indicated service exit while its fake capture still represented a running process
testIterations.fix: Align fake process and status state; production correctly blocked the inconsistent observation

testIterations.cause: Assertion assumed successful TERM dispatch even in injected TERM command failure
testIterations.fix: Use production coordinator recorded TERM initiation; KILL still requires at least five seconds
